N621 gives a source-reported complete reciprocity hierarchy in an ideal model but no finite-resource sensor or practical advantage. Attention-edit and phase-pair candidates remain closed at their gates.

status_note: Mathematical constructions remain scoped candidates; acquisition advantage and capability are separate unresolved claims.
strongest_obstacle: The population scheme assumes native writing and tag stability. The endpoint scheme assumes signal-dependent coherent coupling but offers no uniformly bounded word length, statistical power or exclusive observable.
